description: Leverage codebase-memory MCP structural graph tools for project analysis.

When asked about workspace architecture, file relationships, function references, or legacy code tracing, prioritize utilizing the `codebase-memory` MCP tools.

- Avoid full-text directory grepping or reading files sequentially when a structural graph query can resolve dependencies or symbols.
- Reference the persistent knowledge graph to check blast radius or dead code before making modifications.
